author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon card binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 Contact via replies with portfolios, pricing, and availability.

author: Meg Humble
title: Seeking character artists for 2 full body characters under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰

author: Romance Fiction Club
title: Hiring character artist for large project
content: We’re looking to hire a character artist who can take on a large project. Any authors have reccomendations? Human made artwork only please. Contact via author recommendations in comments.

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability through end of 2026
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact by commenting with portfolio, price list, and examples.

author: Or Cole
title: Seeking character artist for upcoming book with flexible payments
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! (Romance author)

author: Squirrel
title: Calling artists for character art of two main characters for self-published novel
content: 🎨 Calling all artists! I’m planning to self-publish my novel within the next year and I’m looking for an artist to create character art for my two main characters. ✨ One important requirement: NO AI art or AI tools used at any stage of the process. I had a bad experience earlier this year with someone who claimed their work was fully human-made, only to discover otherwise after paying. I want to work with a real artist and support genuine creativity, and I’m happy to pay fairly for your work! Contact via replies.
